description: This file defines Express routes for doctor-related functionalities in a backend API, setting up endpoints for login, appointment management, profile management, and dashboard access.

methods.name: POST /cancel-appointment
methods.description: Allows a doctor to cancel an appointment after authentication.

methods.name: GET /appointments
methods.description: Fetches appointments for the authenticated doctor.

methods.name: POST /change-availability
methods.description: Allows a doctor to change their availability status.

methods.name: GET /dashboard
methods.description: Provides dashboard data for the doctor.

methods.name: GET /profile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the doctor.

methods.name: POST /update-profile
methods.description: Updates the profile information of the doctor.
